about_the_game:
Noble Legacy is a medieval city building game from a 3rd person perspective. With the depth of city building simulation games and the immersiveness of 3rd person RPGs.

In Noble Legacy you are the lord of all your lands. Rule the land with an unyielding hand and bring growth and prosperity to what you have built. Rally the worthy and unite the people under your crown.

 

                                                    “Let your legacy be written…”

Your villagers aren’t just NPCs—they’re the lifeblood of your realm. Each one has unique skills, traits, and personality quirks that affect how they work, who they get along with, and how your town evolves.

Immersive villager simulation with leveling, gear, and a deep morale system, requiring the player to constantly be upgrading their villager’s homes, communal buildings, and production capabilities to satisfy their villager’s needs. Recruit higher tier, rare villagers who can craft new things, perform new jobs, and be more efficient in entertaining or tending to your citizens. Plan for their upkeep needs and keep them happy so they work at peak efficiency.

Each villager is unique and will have needs that dynamically change based on your choices and actions. It is up to you to bring out the best in your villagers while balancing their needs, wants, quirks, and general attitudes.

Noble Legacy Features a deep and detailed economic simulation within the game requiring users to learn and deploy villager jobs, resource pipelines, production chains, and agricultural processes to ensure that their villagers are warm, fed, and happy. Earn gold by selling to and entertaining visitors to your village, creating a trade hub for people in the region and enticing interesting and lucrative travelers to your village. Exponential complexity growth with more villagers in the game.

You can decide everything, from the torches that light up their homes, to the types of tables they use at the local tavern. You can build everything from rustic cabins in the woods, to massive towering castles.

Highly customizable, but coupled with a distinct prefab system that will allow users to make detailed villages with low effort and customize just the parts that they want to. Make the buildings attractive to visitors who will spend coin and rate your village.

Use the Noble Legacy's building system to save your designs for quick access to previously created buildings and share them across the realms.

                        Please enjoy our Demo of Noble legacy, we'll see you at launch!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-8700k (6 Core Equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-9700K (8 Core Equivalent) or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
